module.Title: Final Challenge: Defeat the Slime
module.Teaching: Combine variables, a method, a condition, and rewards into a small combat result.
PredictionOptions: When slimeHealth is zero or lower
Every time the method is declared
Only while the slime has full health
module.PredictionExplanation: The <= comparison detects defeat after damage has been subtracted.
module.DebugPrompt: Repair the damage direction, defeat comparison, and reward direction.
module.RecallPrompt: Rebuild AttackSlime from memory. Use these exact identifiers: damage, slimeHealth, status, stoneCount. Use these exact values: 0, 5, "Slime defeated".
module.TransferPrompt: Create AttackBoss that grants 20 coins when bossHealth reaches zero or less. Use these exact identifiers: coinCount, damage, status. Use the exact value "Boss defeated".
module.PreviewMessage: The course ends with a complete combat-and-reward rule.
